import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/test_1.csv"

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Rename columns in df0 to match the target schema suffix "_15"
df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={
    'Happiness Rank': 'Happiness_Rank_15',
    'Happiness Score': 'Happiness_Score_15',
    'Standard Error': 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy (GDP per Capita)': 'Economy_15',
    'Health (Life Expectancy)': 'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Trust (Government Corruption)': 'Trust_15',
    'Generosity': 'Generosity_15',
    'Dystopia Residual': 'Dystopia_15'
})

# Select and reorder columns from df0 to match the target schema for 2015 columns
df0_selected = df0_renamed[[
    'Country', 'Region', 'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy_15', 'Family', 'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom', 'Trust_15',
    'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15'
]]

# Rename columns in df1 to match the target schema suffix "_17"
# Note: df1 columns already mostly match target schema except "Country"
df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={
    'Happiness_Rank_17': 'Happiness_Rank_17',
    'Happiness_Score_17': 'Happiness_Score_17',
    'Whisker_High_17': 'Whisker_High_17',
    'Whisker_Low_17': 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17': 'Economy_17',
    'Family_17': 'Family_17',
    'Life_Expectancy_17': 'Life_Expectancy_17',
    'Freedom_17': 'Freedom_17',
    'Generosity_17': 'Generosity_17',
    'Trust_17': 'Trust_17',
    'Dystopia_17': 'Dystopia_17'
})

# Select columns from df1 to match the target schema for 2017 columns plus Country
df1_selected = df1_renamed[[
    'Country', 'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17',
    'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]]

# Join df0_selected and df1_selected on 'Country'
# Because 'Country' is unique and a key in both tables, this is a natural join key
# We use an inner join to keep only countries present in both datasets (consistent with target examples)
df_merged = pd.merge(df0_selected, df1_selected, on='Country', how='inner', suffixes=('_15', '_17'))

# After merge, 'Region' is only in df0_selected, so it is preserved
# Rename columns to match target schema exactly (some columns from df0_selected and df1_selected)
# Note: 'Family' and 'Freedom' columns from df0_selected and df1_selected have different suffixes after merge
# They are already suffixed by pandas merge, so we rename them explicitly to target names

df_merged = df_merged.rename(columns={
    'Region': 'Region',
    'Family': 'Family_15',
    'Freedom': 'Freedom_15'
})

# Reorder columns to match exactly the target schema order
target_columns = [
    'Country', 'Region',
    'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15',
    'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17', 'Economy_17',
    'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]

# Ensure all target columns exist in df_merged
missing_cols = set(target_columns) - set(df_merged.columns)
if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing columns in merged dataframe: {missing_cols}")

df_final = df_merged[target_columns]

# Convert data types to match target schema explicitly
df_final = df_final.astype({
    'Country': str,
    'Region': str,
    'Happiness_Rank_15': 'Int64',
    'Happiness_Score_15': float,
    'Standard_Error_15': float,
    'Economy_15': float,
    'Family_15': float,
    'Life_Expectancy_15': float,
    'Freedom_15': float,
    'Trust_15': float,
    'Generosity_15': float,
    'Dystopia_15': float,
    'Happiness_Rank_17': 'Int64',
    'Happiness_Score_17': float,
    'Whisker_High_17': float,
    'Whisker_Low_17': float,
    'Economy_17': float,
    'Family_17': float,
    'Life_Expectancy_17': float,
    'Freedom_17': float,
    'Generosity_17': float,
    'Trust_17': float,
    'Dystopia_17': float
})

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
